title: Search filter component audit
purpose: Audit search as its own text-input filter component.
objective: Define search anatomy, placeholder/label behavior, icon/clear affordances, debounce feedback, states, responsive behavior, and customization backlog.
scope_boundary: In scope: label, input, placeholder, optional icon, clear action, focus ring, debounce/loading feedback, states, responsive behavior, and QA scenario. Out of scope: select, date, rating, and implementation.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-001 has classified preset/widget setting ownership and current search render/CSS/JS files are available.
exit_condition: A search audit sheet exists with behavior and controls prioritized.
completion_criteria: Placeholder and label behavior are documented.
Icon, clear action, and debounce feedback are classified as now/later/deferred.
State matrix and responsive behavior are documented.

phases.title: Anatomy
phases.purpose: Map search render, CSS, and JS behavior.

phases.title: Behavior
phases.purpose: Define text input, clear, debounce, and focus contracts.

acceptance_criteria: Audit distinguishes search from generic field styling.
No plugin source changes are made.
